default.title: DOUBLE IN 6 MONTHS
default.speaker: College senior
default.intro: Three months into the job. ₹15,000 sits in savings.
default.text: 'Bro, this group doubles money in 6 months, guaranteed. I put ₹20,000 last month. Spots closing today!'

pocket_money.title: DOUBLE IN 6 MONTHS
pocket_money.speaker: Neighbour uncle
pocket_money.text: 'Beta, my nephew's scheme — 100% return in 6 months, fixed. Only for people I trust. Decide tonight.'

scholarship.title: DOUBLE IN 6 MONTHS
scholarship.speaker: Hostel friend
scholarship.text: A forwarded voice note: 'Guaranteed double in 6 months. Already 300 people in. Last 10 slots!'

earner.title: DOUBLE IN 6 MONTHS
earner.speaker: Old customer
earner.text: 'I remember you from the shop! My company doubles money in 6 months. Put ₹15,000, get ₹30,000. Sign here.'

choices.lesson: A guaranteed double is a guaranteed lie. Bigger promised return = bigger risk, and here the risk was everything.
choices.hint: What's the catch when the reward is unreal?

choices.lesson: Testing a scam with less money is still losing money. The return told you the risk.
Good question. Real investments can tell you who regulates them; this one went quiet.
8% a year, slow and real, beats 100% in 6 months, fast and fake. Return and risk travel together.

default.title: INSTANT LOAN APP
default.speaker: App notification
default.intro: Salary is 9 days away. Phone screen cracked: ₹4,000 to fix.
default.text: '₹5,000 in 2 minutes! No documents, no questions. Just allow contacts + photos. Tap to get cash now.'

pocket_money.title: INSTANT LOAN APP
pocket_money.speaker: App notification
pocket_money.intro: Salary is 9 days away. Mom's medicines: ₹4,000 this week.
pocket_money.text: '₹5,000 in 2 minutes! No documents. Allow contacts + photos and the money is yours.'

scholarship.title: INSTANT LOAN APP
scholarship.speaker: App notification
scholarship.intro: Salary is 9 days away. Hostel deposit due: ₹4,000.
scholarship.text: '₹5,000 in 2 minutes, zero paperwork. Allow contacts + photos to continue.'

earner.title: INSTANT LOAN APP
earner.speaker: App notification
earner.intro: Salary is 9 days away. Dad's shop rent short by ₹4,000.
earner.text: 'Cash in 2 minutes! No documents. Allow contacts + photos. 3,00,000 happy users.'

choices.lesson: ₹5,000 became ₹10,500 owed in weeks, and they messaged your contacts. The permissions were the price.
choices.hint: Why does a lender need your contacts and photos?

choices.lesson: Zero interest, one awkward week. Far better than an app — but a buffer would have cost nothing.

choices.text: USE A CHEAP SCREEN GUARD, FIX ON PAYDAY
choices.lesson: Nine uncomfortable days cost ₹200. The 'instant' loan would have cost ₹5,500 and your peace. Easy money is the most expensive kind.
This is exactly what the jar was for. No lender, no interest, no harassment.

default.title: FAKE SCREENSHOT
default.speaker: Buyer
default.intro: You're selling your old phone online for ₹8,000.
default.text: Buyer at the door: 'Paid! See the screenshot — ₹8,000 successful.' Your phone hasn't pinged. 'Network issue, it'll show in an hour.'

pocket_money.title: FAKE SCREENSHOT
pocket_money.speaker: Buyer
pocket_money.intro: Selling the old TV for ₹8,000 to buy a bigger one.
pocket_money.text: 'Transferred, here's the screenshot.' Your bank app shows nothing. 'Server slow, bro. Let me take it, it'll reflect.'

scholarship.title: FAKE SCREENSHOT
scholarship.speaker: Buyer
scholarship.intro: Selling your laptop for ₹8,000 after an upgrade.
scholarship.text: 'Done, ₹8,000 sent — screenshot attached.' No notification on your side. 'UPI is down today, check the news.'

earner.title: FAKE SCREENSHOT
earner.speaker: Customer
earner.intro: Running your own shop now. Big order: ₹8,000 of stock.
earner.text: Customer loads the car, shows 'Payment successful ₹8,000'. Your QR speaker hasn't announced anything. 'It's processing, I'm in a hurry.'

choices.lesson: A screenshot is a picture. Money arrives only when YOUR app says so. ₹8,000 of goods walked away.
choices.hint: Whose screen proves a payment — theirs or yours?

choices.lesson: Waiting was right; promising to give anyway was not. 'It'll reflect later' is the scam's second line.
Your own app, your own balance — that's the only proof. The 'buyer' disappeared the moment you checked.
Safe, but you lost a real sale too. Checking your own app would have kept both.
